evidence_notes: Diagnosed 18 months ago, likely had it longer. Construction foreman, also pre-diabetic and chronic back pain. Always had stomach issues attributed to job/diet. Blood in stool led to diagnosis of severe disease with multiple strictures. Options limited by other conditions. Prednisone worsened blood sugar. Mesalamine ineffective. Currently on Humira (50% improvement). Company moved him to desk duty due to work limitations. Fears being pushed out of his 28-year job. Wife is working double shifts. Sold assets to manage medical bills. Insurance covers 80% of biologics, still thousands out-of-pocket.
